text: Do not buy! I owned the Cuisinart SS-780, which was the best coffeemaker I ever owned. Since the SS-780 was discontinued by Cuisinart (huge mistake), I thought the SS-10 was the newer version of the SS-780. Was I ever mistaken. The SS-10 was very noisy, was very slow and did not heat up the water above 165-degrees. The coffee it make did not taste right, so I looked up on line what makes great coffee. One key factor is that the water should be between 195 and 205 degrees. I returned the product as defective since it could not heat the water to the required temperature. The SS-780 heats the water to 192 degrees which is much closer to the recommended temperature. You can order the SS-10 and hope it is better than the one I received. But I would recommend you look for the SS-780, which is still available even though it is discontinued. Hope Cuisinart starts making the SS-780 again or at least starts making a model that corrects the defects in the SS-10.

It's fine if I pop the brewed cup into the microwave for about 10 seconds. I also started using a refillable pod with a medium-fine home ground dark coffee which is more economic environmentally friendly. I run a cup of clear water through the machine every six cups or so to make sure the needle doesn't clog.

You have to be careful to press the lid down firmly. When it doesn't "click" it overflows and is very hard to clean,

Lastly, calling it brushed metal in the upper description on Amazon is misleading. It's all plastic.
